bar.name: Linear desktop app
bar.why: Hardest reachable bar for restraint and density. Cropped to pure app chrome so the blind A/B is app-vs-app with no marketing page to give it away. Cloning it counts as a loss, not a win.
shots: ref/BAR-app.png (the blind target, 1270x695 pure app UI)

pieces.name: Shell + Play screen
pieces.gap: The window does not fill vertically: the list is a fixed ten-row slice, so at 2560x1600 a void of 39.5% of the window sits under "All 23 instances".

pieces.name: Instances list
pieces.gap: Squint 1.38 -> 2.42. Remaining: 87% of horizontal growth lands in three empty gutters, and the list does not fill vertically.

pieces.name: Settings
pieces.gap: Still the worst screen: 3.09% ink vs 7.80% on Modules, 27.5% dead area, squint 1.49, no page title, and 750-873px of gutter between every label and its control.

pieces.name: Empty / downloading / error
pieces.gap: Own routes under #states. Never judged on its own.

pieces.name: Tweaks list + settings
pieces.gap: The HUD card grid fixed the loss. Remaining: five container recipes, four of them on this screen alone.

pieces.name: HUD layout editor
pieces.gap: Judged as part of the Tweaks screen. No round of its own yet.

pieces.name: Light theme + palettes
pieces.gap: Accent re-derived to 4.71:1 and light now leads with the same element as dark. Remaining: light has no state layer - the selected nav chip is 6x weaker and vanishes under blur.

note: Tokens, icons, motion and copy are cross-cutting: judged inside every screen rather than as their own round.

decisions.name: Kestrel, placeholder. Note: collides with ASP.NET's web server.
decisions.modLoading: Neutral. No allowlist, no server-facing disclosure, no anticheat.

exitCondition: Beat the bar on the blind design A/B, AND carry zero present items from standard.md sections A/C/F. The 'which is AI-generated' verdict is NO LONGER a gate - measured 2/2 false-positive rate on pairs of real products. See docs/detection-is-not-calibrated.md
record: 20 design wins, 1 loss (Tweaks loss reversed in round 10)
gate: Beat the bar on the blind design A/B, AND carry zero items present from standard.md sections A, C and F, AND hold up as a system: consistent across screens, responsive to window size, and as designed in light as in dark. The system pass is new and is where the work now is.
